title: fleet-write advisory_list fails the whole listing once one state holds more than 100 advisories (next-page link refused)
body:
security#2 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcW9L8Noz9BxEwjwiov

**Defect (tooling).** The relay op `advisory_list` (scripts/pm/fleet-write) refuses the whole stroke as soon as any one state has a second page. The security seats' intake probe is therefore dead once a repository holds more than 100 advisories in one state.

**Measured.**
- 2026-11-21T14:32Z: run 44914435895 succeeded. Total 182, and the largest state held 99.
- That state then grew past 100.
- 2026-11-21T16:19Z and 16:20Z: runs 44923946055 and 44924005513 both fail with exit 5. Job log:

> `✗ action 1 advisory_list: GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/security-advisories?state={triage,draft,closed}&per_page=100 -> a full page's Link header names a next page the relay does not follow — not exactly one rel="next" link, or one off this API's collection or this state, or a cursor that is not exactly one value in its declared shape — so nothing was sealed or emitted`

**Where.** `advisoryListNextCursor` in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`. It follows a next link only when:
- there is exactly one,
- its origin and path equal `/repos/{repo}/security-advisories`,
- it has exactly one `state` equal to the walked state,
- and it has exactly one `after` matching `ADVISORY_LIST_CURSOR_SHAPE`.

**Not measured.** Which of these conditions GitHub's real next link breaks. The seat cannot see the header: the relay prints nothing on refusal, by design. Candidates:
- the link addresses the collection by repository id (`/repositories/{id}/…`);
- it paginates with `page=` and no `after`;
- the cursor has characters outside the shape.

The fix PR measures the real header first. Prefer a runner-side diagnostic that prints only the link's parameter NAMES and the path's shape: never a cursor value, never an advisory field.

**Acceptance.** `advisory_list` walks every page of each of the three states when a state holds more than 100, and seals and emits as today. The self-test gains a fixture using the real next-link shape. Still refused: a link off the collection, off the state, or with an unbounded cursor.

**Impact.** No intake probe for either security seat until fixed. Reading and writing a single advisory is unaffected.

Re-check: `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file <file holding [{"op":"advisory_list"}]> --reveal` from a security seat exits non-zero with the job log line above.
